title: Other New Orleans composers: Braun and Vergis
summary: She did not know Braun or Voges, and the only Vergis she knew was not a musician.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how

blocks.x: Now, there were a whole lot of composers here that I don't know much about, like Billy Braun, William J. Braun. Did you know him?
I just noticed in the article they mentioned so many of them. W.J. Voges, it has.
There was Joe Vergis who was a composer. He wrote Don't Leave Me Daddy. The only Vergis?
The only Vergis that I knew was not in the music business at all.
He was a young man I met when I first came down here. He wasn't in music at all.
